snippet.title: Bacharu Miare no Kuronikuru  - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
“If you’re seeing this… it means the system chose you too.”
“Tell me… are you ready to let an AI rewrite your memories?”

Welcome to The MIARE Project – a psychological sci-fi universe where an AI observes, tests and rewrites human memories.

This teaser shows the first fragments of the story:

Jade Lovenity – the Force, the queen chosen by the system
Raifu Heiwa – the Mind, an artist casting spells with data
Rubik – the Breach, a hacker who refuses to let the AI win
and above them all… M.I.A.R.E., the system watching every move.

This is only a glimpse. The real tests haven’t started yet.

🔔 Subscribe to catch future trailers, devlogs and reveals.
🌐 More info soon: themiareproject.com

#TheMIAREProject #MIARE #indiegame #visualnovel #anime #gamedev
